label: Web platforms: Marketplace, Marketing, Services Platform, Identity, Rewards and Support, plus Conversational AI, Uvation Pulse, Atlas CRM, Devops and Design Marketing Development Collab
note: Web-Marketplace Product Catalog (PC) is reported with Web-Marketplace, because the AI-server catalogue work runs across both boards.

programmes.name: Web-Marketplace
programmes.headline: 13 items closed on 9 Oct, including the three reopened NVIDIA fixes (back in production), six more AI-server catalogue fixes, configurable product upload on UAT (PC-121) and two journey reviews under MT-1586. Smoke testing (MT-1541) started, and the live chat platform choice (MT-1578) moved to Dev on its due date. A US tax-rate sourcing task (MT-1601) was raised. 24 items are past due, 20 of them untouched in 30 days.

programmes.name: Web-Marketing
programmes.headline: 15 tickets were raised on 9 Oct, mostly chatbot and page polish subtasks for Kunal Jangid from Kannan Elangovan's review, and a shareable chatbot package for the Marketplace (MR-1335) was built and closed the same day. The sitemap fix (MR-1199) is still Ready for Prod and related products content (MR-1265) is still blocked. Open bugs are 20, none rated; 9 items are past due.

programmes.name: Web-Uvation Services Platform
programmes.headline: Livian Stefan Stan raised a Go Live plan on 9 Oct: five epics and 95 stories and subtasks (tax, contract proposal, payments and invoicing, dashboard, upgrade), mostly for Silviu Oltean and Cășvan Marcel, due 2 Nov to 15 Dec. 15 items closed, including Support Hub v1 (USP-4028) and the S1 deposit deduction bug (USP-4095); open bugs fell from 47 to 37. Two S1 bugs remain (USP-4231, USP-4204). The overdue Sept 2nd Sprint now holds 3 tickets.

programmes.name: Uvation Conversational AI
programmes.headline: One chatbot booking-confirmation bug (UC-233) was raised and is in development. Marketplace sign-in (UC-225), the Teams handoff (UC-22) and model selection (UC-26) are in progress for 15 Oct; admin analytics (UC-25) has not started. 25 items are past due, all untouched since August.

programmes.name: Uvation Pulse
programmes.headline: No change on the Pulse board. Anshul Bhargava's time on 9 Oct went to the Interactive AI Factory: its plan was published on Confluence (PRD-1) and 98 tasks were raised in Uvation Projects, outside this report's boards.

programmes.name: Atlas CRM
programmes.headline: No change on 9 Oct. The three items (ATLAS-1 to ATLAS-3) are in To Do with no due dates; the CRM MVP plan date is still not in Jira.

programmes.name: Web-Identity
programmes.headline: The account deletion flow moved to Dev on 9 Oct (ID-743, ID-748 to ID-750, ID-756) and support reactivation (ID-751) started. The 6 past-due claims-removal tasks (ID-679 to ID-684) are in production but not closed.

programmes.name: Web-Rewards
programmes.headline: No change on 9 Oct. The 18 regression-test items raised on 30 Sep are all To Do, unassigned and undated; one older bug (REW-156) is in UAT.

programmes.name: Web-Support
programmes.headline: No Web-Support ticket was created or updated in the last 30 days.

programmes.name: Devops
programmes.headline: The Azure Virtual Desktop design document (IN-1148) was finished on 9 Oct, and a production network and DNS maintenance task was done the same day. 15 items still sit in BLOCKER status, most held by k.kishore, and 24 are past due; the S1 login error-page bug (IN-1111) is still To Do.

programmes.name: Design Marketing Development Collab
programmes.headline: Three marketing-site fixes were raised for Shashi Prasad K on 9 Oct, including a login page returning 403 (DM-1088). 28 items are past due, 25 of them untouched in 30 days. The design team's own timelines are covered under Dependencies.
